note: Text-only 501B MoE model with 23B active parameters for coding, reasoning, and agents. Early version available to a select group of users; planned weights are not yet public and are due later in October, with broader access through a waitlist.

Apache-2.0 740M on-device multimodal embedding model built on Gemma 4, mapping text, code, images, audio, and video into a shared space. Public weights on Hugging Face and Kaggle; modular text, vision, and audio encoders with 8K context.

Small model for high-volume summaries, classification, compaction, browser use, and coding subagents. Available on the Claude Platform as claude-haiku-5-5 and through AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

Open-weight edge decision models returning typed answers and calibrated probabilities in one forward pass. d1-3B handles text and vision; the early research d1-omni-600M also accepts audio. Weights available on Hugging Face under the LFM Open License.

MIT-licensed 0.6B and 9B multimodal late-interaction embedding models for text, images, and visual documents. Both share an embedding space; public weights produce 128-dimensional vectors per token for MaxSim retrieval.

Natively multimodal flagship for coding, agents, and enterprise work, available in public API preview through Mistral Studio. Planned open weights are not yet public; Mistral says they will follow by the end of October.

Updated image generation and conversational editing model, available as gemini-nano-banana-2.1 through the Gemini API. Supports text/image input, image/text output, search grounding, and batch processing.

Updated Apache-2.0 multimodal decision weights using the same Qwen3.8-27B backbone as v1, with revised attention and additional training data. Public weights and inference code are available; a materially distinct checkpoint rather than a pricing-only change.

Hosted unified image generation and editing release, dated by QwenCloud's model changelog. Adds native RGBA transparency, subject extraction, up to 10 reference images, and marked or masked local editing. Separate from the earlier Qwen-Image-2.1 open-weight event.

Apache-2.0 decision models based on Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.5-9B, respectively, returning bounded structured choices. Released weights on Hugging Face and hosted APIs on Workers AI; compatible with the Jev decision API.

Multilingual text-to-speech family with cross-language voice cloning, supporting 23 languages and 26 locales. The Flash variant targets latency-sensitive voice agents; available through MAI Playground and Microsoft Foundry's Azure Speech.

First streaming MAI transcription model, producing evolving partial and final transcripts in 60 languages with automatic continuous language detection. Available through Azure Speech for live voice agents, dictation, and subtitling.

Apache-2.0 decision model fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B, returning selected choices and calibrated probabilities for text and image inputs. Public weights and inference example released on Hugging Face.

Small Apache-2.0 open decision model for local experimentation, routing, and tool-call checks. Chooses among supplied options or scores inputs with confidence rather than generating free-form text; weights, code, and training recipe released.

Image generation and editing model with bounding-box composition, targeted edits, up to 10 reference images, and output up to 4K. Available through the BFL API and playground; commercial weights access is separate from a public open-weight release.

Full-duplex audiovisual interaction system perceiving and generating speech and video concurrently. Research preview available to selected trusted testers; not yet available to customers on the Tavus platform, with access requests by form.

Hosted hybrid reasoning model for coding, agents, and long-document analysis. Vercel's September 30 launch confirms access as inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash, with 560B total/25B active parameters and 262K context on AI Gateway; this predates the October 2 OpenRouter listing.

MIT-licensed contextual embedding preview encoding document chunks jointly so each vector reflects surrounding context. Public weights return one embedding per chunk; preview embeddings and interfaces may change incompatibly in later releases.

Hosted text-to-image and reference-image generation with multi-turn editing. September 22 availability is evidenced by ComfyUI's merged Tencent partner nodes; the October 5 OpenRouter listing is a later access expansion. No public weights verified.
New preview release of the multi-model Pareto system for coding, research, and agents; available through the Unbiased API under pareto and through OpenRouter.
Frontier model for long-horizon coding, professional work, and cybersecurity; rolling out to trusted defenders through the Fairwind Program, not yet generally available to developers or consumers.
Pro and Fast multimodal embedding models share an embedding space, support over 100 languages and 128K context, and are available through the Embed API and enterprise deployment channels.
General-purpose text-, image-, and reference-to-video model with generated audio, built on MiniMax H3 and post-trained by HeyGen; available through the HeyGen API and partner integrations.

Video model entering restricted early access, with broader rollout planned for October; supports native 30-second generation, audiovisual output, omni references, and multiple keyframes. Native 4K HDR is described as coming soon.
World action model for robot control based on video pretraining; running on selected partners' hardware with additional pre-launch access by inquiry. Planned open weights are not yet public.

Updated GPT-6 Sol successor for coding, computer use, and professional work, available as gpt-6.1-sol; 1.05M context and 128K output. Responses supports tools and beta multi-agent delegation; Chat Completions supports use without tools.

Second Claude 5.5 model for coding and professional work, available through Claude apps, Claude Code, the API, and cloud partners; Anthropic reports faster execution and lower typical cost than Sonnet 5.

New expressive text-to-speech generation with contextual tone and pacing, audio tags, and improved pronunciation; Turbo targets low-latency agents. Available across ElevenAPI, ElevenAgents, and ElevenCreative.
Fast tier of Kling 4.0 video generation, initially available to Ultra Yearly subscribers ahead of the wider Kling 4.0 rollout.
MIT-licensed 309B MoE with 15.5B active parameters and native 1M context for coding and AI research; weights and inference code released publicly, with API access announced separately.

Updated Pro-MOPD and Flash-MOPD weights fix repeated tool calls through a revised final distillation run. The API switched to the repaired checkpoints on September 25 Beijing time; public weights and the write-up followed September 27.
Multimodal coding and agent preview with 1M context and adjustable reasoning depth; initial access through MiniMax Code and the Token Plan. Thinking cannot be disabled; no public weights.
Hosted multimodal preview for long-horizon agent work and coding, adding image understanding to the LongCat line; available through the LongCat API, with no public weights verified.
Multimodal chat-completions model adding audio input and optional video soundtrack analysis alongside vision; model ID perceptron-mk1.5, with a shared 36,864-token context.
Anonymous coding model launched as a free limited-time stealth API through Vercel AI Gateway. Maker unconfirmed; this records the historical launch, not continued availability.

Structured hosted model for parallel classification, yes/no decisions, and scoring, returning probability distributions and confidence for routing, moderation, and validation. API ID decision-model-preview.
Anonymous hosted coding and multimodal reasoning preview with 1M context, accessible through OpenRouter and OpenCode. Maker undisclosed; OpenRouter lists withdrawal on October 5.
Hosted roleplaying and storytelling systems built from several specialized GLM-based models; standard and Mini variants listed on OpenRouter with 262K context.
